inputs.name: server
inputs.description: One k3s server to run kubectl on: an address, or a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file or jump_hosts.

inputs.name: git_url
inputs.description: Git repository Flux watches, as an ssh://, https:// or http:// URL. This goes into state, so credentials belong in git_ssh_private_key or git_password.

inputs.name: git_path
inputs.description: Directory in the repository to reconcile, relative to its root.

inputs.name: git_auth
inputs.description: How Flux logs in to the repository: "none", "ssh" (git_ssh_private_key and git_known_hosts) or "https" (git_username and git_password).

inputs.name: git_ssh_private_key
inputs.description: Private key Flux logs in with, in PEM or OpenSSH form, for git_auth = "ssh". Never reaches state.

inputs.name: git_known_hosts
inputs.description: known_hosts lines for the Git server, for git_auth = "ssh", such as the output of ssh-keyscan. Flux refuses SSH without them.

inputs.name: git_username
inputs.description: User name for git_auth = "https". Many Git hosts take anything here when the password is a token.

inputs.name: git_password
inputs.description: Password or token for git_auth = "https". Never reaches state.

inputs.name: git_ca_cert
inputs.description: PEM certificate of the CA that signed the Git server's certificate, for git_auth = "https" against a private CA.

inputs.name: interval
inputs.description: How often Flux checks the repository and reconciles it, as a Go duration such as "1m" or "1h".

inputs.name: prune
inputs.description: Delete from the cluster what has been deleted from the repository.

inputs.name: flux_version
inputs.description: Flux release to install, from https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/releases. Change it with install_sha256 and k3s_minors.

inputs.name: k3s_minors
inputs.description: Kubernetes minor versions the server's k3s may run, from the release notes of flux_version. Anything else fails the apply before Flux is touched.
